messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected for serving runtime in prod-us-west2. Symptoms: repeated OOMs in model-server pods, CUDA errors, and pod evictions. ~12% of requests returning 5xx. Trigger: kubelet eviction due to ephemeral-storage pressure on nodes. Paging oncall. Please ack.
alex (oncall): ACK. Jumping in — collecting context. Which node pools are impacted?
jordan (eng-runtime): quick summary from metrics: model-cache thrash spikes started at 03:12 UTC. Disk utilization on /var/lib/model-cache jumped to 98% on nodes node-pool-gpu-a-3..7. JVM/container OOMs and liveness restarts followed. CUDA errors in logs look like context switch timeouts after repeated restarts.
samir (eng-sre): seeing kubelet eviction messages in nodes: "eviction manager: attempting to reclaim ephemeral-storage" and pods getting Terminated: OOMKilled or Evicted. kube-system kubelet logs attached in fragments below.
alex (oncall): paste logs pls
jordan (eng-runtime): ```
Mar 20 03:14:22 node-pool-gpu-a-5 kubelet[1234]: eviction manager: attempting to reclaim ephemeral-storage
Mar 20 03:14:22 node-pool-gpu-a-5 kubelet[1234]: Pod nginx-model-cache-xyz evicted, reason: "This node has disk pressure"
Mar 20 03:15:01 node-pool-gpu-a-5 dockerd[987]: overlayfs: backing_dev is full, write failed
Mar 20 03:16:10 model-server[pid]: ERROR: cuda: cuCtxCreate failed: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY (702)
```
jordan (eng-runtime): also saw lots of model cache churn; cache size per pod is set to 40GB in the runtime config for some heavy models — that was optimistic for these nodes after recent image layers increased disk footprint.
alex (oncall): do we have a quick mitigation to stop further evictions and keep customer traffic alive?
samir (eng-sre): immediate options:
- cordon & drain the worst nodes and restart with emptied model cache (graceful drain to shift traffic).
- reduce cache footprint by patching runtime config (runtime-config injection) to set cache.max_size to 4GB for affected model families.
- increase node ephemeral-storage (node replacement with larger disk) — slower.
- create a temporary taint to move non-critical pods off GPU nodes.
jordan (eng-runtime): fastest low-risk action: update runtime config that controls model cache eviction LRU and max_size. We can push a dynamic config that new pods will pick up and prune caches immediately. I'll prepare the patch.
alex (oncall): do it. Also notify CS about impacted customers and mitigation steps.
jordan (eng-runtime): applying patch now: ```
kubectl -n redwood patch configmap runtime-config --type=json -p='[ {"op":"replace","path":"/data/model_cache_max_size","value":"4G"}, {"op":"replace","path":"/data/cache_eviction_policy","value":"aggressive"} ]'
```
deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: runtime-config patch -> rollout started. rollout-id: rcfg-20260320-001 :rocket:
alex (oncall): rolling restart pods in affected namespace to pick up config. Use 30s stagger.
samir (eng-sre): running drain on node-pool-gpu-a-5 (cordon first)
samir (eng-sre): ```
kubectl cordon node-pool-gpu-a-5
kubectl drain node-pool-gpu-a-5 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force --grace-period=60
```
priya (oncall-night): I'll take the handoff in 20m. What's the customer impact so I can brief support? Also confirm whether the rollback is needed if it gets worse.
alex (oncall): customer impact: about 8% of requests for models in prod-us-west2  had elevated latency and 12% 5xx rate at peak. Affected customers: Acme Travel (high), internal test harness (low). CS to reach out to paying customers.
ravi (customer-success): on it. I'll DM Acme Travel with an incident acknowledgment and ETA 30m, will offer temporary routing to other regions if acceptable.
jordan (eng-runtime): post-patch observations: cache pruning started, disk usage per pod dropped from ~90% to ~55% on restarted pods. Error rate dropping.
alex (oncall): nice. Logs show fewer CUDA OOMs now. Any follow-up infra steps?
samir (eng-sre): longer term: reduce base image layer size, ensure model cache uses ephemeral local PV with eviction thresholds, and add disk pressure alerts early (80% not 95%). Also add emergency config to cap cache per-node based on free ephemeral.
alex (oncall): priya, here's your handoff summary (copy):
- Incident: ephemeral-storage pressure causing pod evictions and runtime OOMs in prod-us-west2
- Start: 1763501234 (03:12 UTC). Current status: mitigated, rollout of cache cap in progress, node drains underway.
- Action items: monitor error rate & latency, complete node drains, consider replacing smallest-disk nodes, and coordinate with CS for customer follow-ups.
- Key contacts: jordan (eng-runtime), samir (eng-sre), ravi (CS)
priya (oncall-night): ACK. I'll monitor alerts and escalate to infra if eviction resumes. If 5xx rate goes above 3% sustained for 5m, I'll execute temporary cross-region routing for critical customers.
jordan (eng-runtime): note for postmortem: add a check in model onboarding to abort huge cache defaults on small node types. Also log release that bumped image layers last week.
alex (oncall): can someone open an incident record + postmortem ticket and assign to eng-runtime and eng-sre?
samir (eng-sre): opening incident ticket now: INC-20260320-27. Adding initial timeline and logs.
samir (eng-sre): created postmortem draft and assigned. Will add heap of kubelet logs and node disk metrics.
ravi (customer-success): Acme Travel acknowledged, prefers cross-region fallback rather than waiting for node replacement. We're coordinating.
deploy-bot: rollout rcfg-20260320-001 completed: 42/42 pods restarted, observed config applied.
jordan (eng-runtime): metrics: 5xx down to 1.2% and tail latency returning to normal. Closing active mitigations, leaving nodes cordoned until next maintenance window.
alex (oncall): thanks all. Priya, you're owning the rest of the watch. I'll update leadership and mark as handled for my shift.
priya (oncall-night): taking over. I'll post a follow-up summary in #postmortems once we have root cause. :white_check_mark:
alex (oncall): closing channel for handoff. Add any outstanding notes here.
jordan (eng-runtime): one more note — we should add disk usage forecasting alerts and a pre-eviction runbook for oncall. I'll draft a runbook PR.
priya (oncall-night): Copy. If anything regresses ping me @priya.
ravi (customer-success): final: Acme Travel asked for incident timeline and mitigation notes; I'll attach the postmortem when available. Thanks team. :pray:
